messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout v3.2.0 -> models/text-embed-redwood-v3 at 5% in eu-west1. ID: deploy/33487. /status https://deploys.redwood/internal/33487
maria: seeing embedding latency + error rate on eu-west, samples failing similarity checks :thinking_face:
jon: can you paste the quick logs? recent trace ids?
maria: pasted small sample below
maria: ```
ERROR embed-service: timeout writing to GPU pool
trace_id=01f3b
p95_latency=1.9s vs baseline 0.3s
quality_drop=cos_sim -0.12 vs baseline
```
devon: who owns the embed model variant? shouldn't we pin back to v2 until we investigate? :eyes:
maria: +1 - quality regression is user-visible in search results
tara: +1 from PM side, hold traffic and notify customers if we need rollback
jon: deploy-bot, can you hold the rollout? pin route eu-west1 to models/text-embed-redwood-v2-q4
deploy-bot: Acknowledge. Pausing staged rollout 33487. Routing rule applied: eu-west1 -> models/text-embed-redwood-v2-q4 (pinned). Actor: jon. timestamp=2723456820
sre-bot: Alert: automatic circuit opened for embed-service in eu-west1, scaled to 0 replicas for new variants. Ops oncall: devon
devon: looking at the KVM cache pressure, kv-store spikes with new quantization. rolling a quick revert to earlier quantization setting for v3 might help, but pin is safest.
jon: can we avoid full rollback? pin + config tweak for v3, then run synthetic evals
maria: going to run a small eval set on pinned path to confirm v2 results restored
tara: I'll update release notes and send an incident banner to customers if we escalate. Draft:
"We paused the canary for 3.2.0 in eu-west1 due to embedding regressions; traffic is pinned to the previous embed model. Investigating; updates soon."

jon: next steps: 1) run evals on pinned traffic (maria), 2) try config tweak on a dev instance (devon), 3) decide rollback vs patch in 30m (all)
maria: evals showing restored metrics, p95 back to 0.32s, cos_sim within baseline +/-0.02
devon: quick tweak reduced memory pressure by 12% in dev env. preparing patch PR now.
jon: ok reconvene in 30. If patch passes canary we resume from 2.5% then 5% after 15m. If not, we'll roll forward with pinned v2 and schedule full rollback.
maria: thanks team. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: rollout 33487 remains paused. Pin in place. To resume run: `deploy-bot resume 33487 --traffic=2.5%`
